senses.gloss:
Uccaiśravas
(‘[the horse whose] ears are erect and high’)
------------------------------------------
This is a divine horse that emerged out of the क्षीरसमुद्र (milk-ocean) at the time of its churning (See SAMUDRA-MATHANA.) by the gods and the demons. इन्द्र chose to accept it as his royal horse (vide Bhāgavata 8.8).
It was pure white in colour.
The ड़थेर् of सत्यवती (queen of the king Śantanu) was also known as उच्चैश्रवस्.
